irregularities.title: 'Justin Jefferson' is listed under conflicting clubs
irregularities.detail: Sources disagree about which club 'Justin Jefferson' belongs to (CLE, MIN). This is usually an upstream data error (wrong club attached to a player record) and must be reviewed before the row is trusted. No club was assigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Designation conflict for Akayleb Evans
irregularities.detail: nfl.com (official) says OUT; ESPN says ACTIVE. The OFFICIAL nfl.com designation is the one published on this site, because only the league's Game Status Report is binding. The ESPN value is retained on the record for review.

irregularities.title: 102 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 38 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: PHI:john-bates (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:treylon-burks (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:jayden-daniels (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:stefon-diggs (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:javon-kinlaw (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:marcus-mariota (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:fabian-moreau (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:jer-zhan-newton (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:charles-omenihu (official report lists the player under a different club); PHI:colson-yankoff (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:joe-cardona (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:desjuan-johnson (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:nate-landman (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:trent-mcduffie (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:colby-parkinson (official report lists the player under a different club); LAC:coleman-shelton (official report lists the player under a different club); LAR:ben-brown (official report lists the player under a different club); LAR:aj-brown (official report lists the player under a different club); LAR:marcus-bryant (official report lists the player under a different club); LAR:kevin-byard (official report lists the player under a different club) (+18 more). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 2 clubs (CIN, CLE)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
